traits.name: Keen Sight and Smell
traits.description: The owlbear has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

multiattack_text: The owlbear makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its claws.

attacks.name: Beak
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

attacks.name: Claws
attacks.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage.
